patch.title: Short-Term Chat / Session Context Carryover Design

decision: CHAT CONTEXT CARRYOVER DESIGN PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS

diagnosticIntegration.diagnosticDecision: CHAT CONTEXT CARRYOVER DIAGNOSTIC PASS WITH FINDINGS

problemStatement.expectedStandaloneQuery: Is fresh frozen seafood subject to VAT in the Philippines?
problemStatement.currentLikelyBehavior: Classifier and retriever see only 'How about fresh frozen seafood?', losing the VAT issue before answer generation.
problemStatement.summary: Classification and retrieval are current-query-only; conversationHistory reaches only the final prompt (too late). A standaloneQuery must be built before classification and retrieval.

designGoals: preserve short-term context for follow-up questions
rewrite elliptical query into a standaloneQuery before issue classification
use the standaloneQuery before retrieval query construction
preserve source-authority discipline (no authority from history alone)
minimize privacy/security risk (bounded, redacted, no unnecessary egress)
remain compatible with the existing askHandler and 12 mode routes
nonGoals: no Phase 10 source governance / currentness / court metadata
no runtime change in this patch

shortTermContextModel.currentQuery: The raw current user message, e.g. 'How about fresh frozen seafood?'. Always preserved.
shortTermContextModel.recentTurns: A bounded list of recent user/assistant turns from the SAME active conversation/session only. Recommended <= 6 turns for rewrite/classification; never more than the 20 already-fetched history turns. Exact value finalized in implementation.
shortTermContextModel.activeConversationId: Optional conversationId/sessionId/x-conversation-id, used to fetch recent turns server-side when available.
shortTermContextModel.optionalClientRecentTurns: Optional future API contract: bounded recentTurns/messages sent by the frontend. Must be validated and bounded, and never trusted for authority.
shortTermContextModel.shortTermContext: A sanitized/bounded object containing only recent-turn context needed for follow-up resolution (prior issue type, jurisdiction, taxpayer/transaction type). No client-confidential facts beyond what is safely present in recentTurns.
shortTermContextModel.standaloneQuery: A rewritten standalone question used before classification and retrieval, e.g. 'Is fresh frozen seafood subject to VAT in the Philippines?'.

contextCarryoverDecision.note: Explains whether rewrite was applied and why; carries no legal authority.

inputContractDesign.optionalFutureClientRecentTurns: messages[]/recentTurns[] may be supported ONLY if bounded and validated; requires a separate frontend patch.
inputContractDesign.precedenceRule: If both server-side conversation history and client-supplied recentTurns exist, the server-side trusted conversation history takes precedence (or merges only under strict validation).
inputContractDesign.note: Server-side history via getHistory(conversationId, 20) remains preferred when available.

standaloneQueryDesign.traceability: contextCarryoverDecision links standaloneQuery to originalQuery and the sourceTurnIndexes used.
standaloneQueryDesign.note: The standaloneQuery improves query construction only; it never creates authority.

negativeExamples: In the US, how is this taxed?
followUpDetectionDesign.purity: followUpDetector should be a pure, deterministic helper with no I/O.

allowedInheritedAttributes: tax_type / issue_type (VAT, EWT, CWT, income tax, percentage tax, NOLCO, MCIT, PEZA zero-rating, withholding on rent)
notInherited: client facts not repeated within recentTurns and safe

pipelinePlacementDesign.placement: After request parsing and conversationHistory fetch; BEFORE issue classification; BEFORE retrieval query construction; BEFORE source availability / source card decisioning; BEFORE final answer generation.
order: issue classification using standaloneQuery (+ currentQuery metadata)
final prompt using currentQuery, standaloneQuery decision if needed, retrieved sources, and bounded history

fallbackBehavior.noConversationIdOrHistory: Classify the current query normally; do not fabricate context.
fallbackBehavior.emptyRecentTurns: Do not pretend context exists; classify current query normally.
fallbackBehavior.lowConfidenceRewrite: Do not apply rewrite; optionally ask a clarifying question.
fallbackBehavior.newTopicDetected: Do not inherit; treat as a new query.
fallbackBehavior.ambiguityClarificationExample: For 'How about fresh frozen seafood?' with no VAT context: ask 'Are you asking whether fresh frozen seafood is subject to VAT in the Philippines?'

doNotInheritWhen: user explicitly starts a new issue
inherited issue would create legal/tax misclassification
current query is independently complete and different

loggingEgressControls.aligimentWithPhase8SSecretsEnvLoggingGat: PATCH-08S-SECRETS-ENV-LOGGING-SAFETY-GATE-1 log-redaction and third-party egress policies apply to recentTurns.

tenantIsolationBoundary.alignmentWithPhase8STenantIsolationGate: PATCH-08S-TENANT-ISOLATION-GATE-1 remains mandatory before any user/client/matter persistence.

modeCompatibility.note: POST /ask and the 11 other mode routes (/tax /review /quiz /diagnostic /source /audit /case /debug /patch /progress /feedback) all delegate to askHandler; the standaloneQuery stage should be applied centrally.

futurePatchSequence.description: Pure helper only (followUpDetector + standaloneQuery builder + contextCarryoverDecision); no route/pipeline behavior change; unit tests + tax follow-up fixture cases.
Feature-flagged wiring of the standaloneQuery stage before classification/retrieval; bounded recentTurns only; no persistent memory; OFF by default.
Live safe staging smoke with synthetic non-client tax follow-ups (e.g., tobacco VAT -> fresh frozen seafood).
Frontend contract verification if/when the frontend repo is available: confirm conversationId/sessionId is sent, or add bounded recentTurns.

risks: wrong issue inheritance (inheriting the wrong tax type)
stale context (inheriting from an old turn)
jurisdiction contamination (carrying PH context into a non-PH question)
frontend not sending conversationId (context silently empty)
over-reliance on a prior uncertain assistant answer
retrieval drift from an incorrect standaloneQuery
source mismatch (retrieved sources not matching the rewritten intent)
Phase 9 sensitive-workflow exposure if recentTurns include client/matter facts

testCases.expect: CHAT CONTEXT CARRYOVER DESIGN PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS
pipeline order places standaloneQuery before classification and retrieval
prompt integration states prompt was not the root cause
bounded recentTurns, no raw logs, no P1/P2 egress, no memory flags
frontend not verified in backend repo
no persistent memory, no memory flags
